name: Paper Cut (US)

update.channel: GitHub releases (one APK per disc release: papercut-<v>-eu-android-arm64.apk); the app can download and install its own updates

assets.needs: Your own US disc image, game ID G8ME01 (.iso, .gcm or .rvz). This is the US app; upstream ships separate EU (G8MP01) and JP (G8MJ01) APKs.
assets.location: Added to the launcher's library with the system file picker (persistable content:// URI); nothing is copied to a fixed path.
assets.notes: Add the disc with 'Add a disc image'. With 'Skip to this disc next time' on, the app boots straight to the game. Settings > Gameplay has presets such as Vanilla+.

settings.in_app_menu: Launcher > Settings, or in game: the Start menu's settings page (controller Back/Select, or a three-finger tap).
settings.summary: framerate 60/120/144/240/display (frame interpolation), resolution (window or 1-8x 640x480), widescreen, wide HUD, 4x MSAA, sharp texture filter, no pop-in, VSync, FPS overlay; text speed, skip intro, run speed, fast-forward speed; EU: language and 50 Hz.

controls: SDL3/Aurora input: controllers, keyboard and mouse, and touch (on-screen stick and buttons with size/opacity, auto-run, fixed stick, tap = A).
display: Dual-screen aware: when a second display exists it shows a companion page there (Party, Map, Battle info, Crystal Stars) through an Android Presentation (TtydCompanion). Recompa's index also marks it dual_screen. Any aspect ratio; landscape by default.
saves: Memory cards beside settings.txt in Aurora's user folder (expected /data/data/dev.ttyd.port.us/files/, root-only).
notes: The EU and US builds are separate apps; install the one that matches the disc's region. Touch buttons hide when the controller is used.
verified: Device: dumpsys, data dirs. APK: jadx (TtydActivity, TtydCompanion), native strings (settings.txt, disc IDs). Source: settings_aurora.c and settings.h at tag v0.5.1 (key list, ranges, defaults), README, docs. Not checked: the user-folder path on Android (SDL pref path assumed), whether the EU app takes a US disc.
